resources.string: No paired OBD adapter found.\n\nPair the ELM327 first in Android → Bluetooth (PIN is usually 1234 or 0000) and close any other OBD app (Torque). Paired now: %1$s
Which one is the OBD adapter?

Reads the engine control unit through %1$s: what data it offers, its current values, stored fault codes and 20 s of live RPM, speed, temperature and throttle.\n\nRead only: it never clears codes or sends anything to the bike. Contact on (engine running is better) and Torque closed.
Couldn\'t connect to the adapter. Is it paired, powered (contact on) and not in use by another app?
The adapter answered but the engine control unit didn\'t. Turn the contact on (or start the engine) and try again.
Everything is in the log too: ❓ Help → Share logs.
